**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 already reflects our preferred audit position in full:

- **Frequency:** no more than once in any twelve-month period (§ 22.1)
- **Notice:** at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, without unreasonable disruption (§ 22.1)
- **Manner:** off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§ 22.1)
- **Cost:** Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§ 22.2)
- **System access:** expressly prohibited — Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information (§ 22.2)

Section 22.3 adds further Customer-favourable protections (findings are Customer Confidential Information, enforcement-only use, copy of the final report, and shortfall payment resolving the audited quantity).

Per the planner hint, I also confirmed Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) is heading-only with no substantive paragraphs, and a document-wide search for inspection/verification/monitoring/records language surfaced no other audit path binding Customer. No walk-away triggers (unlimited/unannounced audits or remote system access) are present.
